RPC 契約

UI・Web・Agent が tsugumid と話す RPC の一覧です。protocol/tsugumi.fbs の doc comment から生成しているので、説明は英語のままです。

  • 形式: 1 メッセージが 1 つの FlatBuffer（root は Tsugumi.RPC.Message、file identifier は TSG1）。WebSocket の subprotocol は tsugumi.rpc.v1、Unix ソケットは 4 byte の長さ（little endian）に続けて本体です。
  • 失敗: どの要求にも Failure で答えることがあります。
  • 変更を伴う要求: op_id を持ち、同じ op_id の再送は 1 回だけ適用されます。応答を失ったら OperationGet で確かめます。
  • Agent の tool: 同じスキーマ（tsugumi.bfbs）から作ります（主要機能）。

要求は 36 種あります。

接続

要求応答説明
SessionHelloHelloResulttoken is required on WebSocket. Project mismatch is permission_denied. Must be the first request, within 5 s of connecting. protocol is the newest version the client speaks and min_protocol the oldest (default: protocol); the server answers with the newest version both speak (HelloResult.protocol), or protocol_mismatch.

SessionHello

フィールド型必須説明
protocoluint32
client_idstringはい
expected_project_idstring
tokenstring
min_protocoluint32

プロジェクトと保存

要求応答説明
ProjectOpenOpenResultCreates (or replaces) the connection's subscription.
ProjectCloseAckEnds only the given subscription. Unknown ids are acknowledged.
ProjectInspectProjectSnapshotNo subscription, build or reload.
ProjectSave
ProjectReloadSaveResultTakes external edits of the allowed area into the document.
ProjectValidateProjectValidateResulttargets = [] means everything; mode = executable. With changes (the same as project_save's), the document as it would be after them is checked and nothing is saved: try definitions, _outputs.fbs and default.nix text here instead of saving trial versions.
ProjectImportProjectImportResultdefinitions = [] imports every definition of the grant.
ProjectCacheClearProjectCacheClearResultOnly while no run or SDK job is active.
OperationGetOperationResult

版

要求応答説明
VersionInitVersionResultMakes the project a git repository: a first commit of what is saved (a demo's history file becomes its versions). Nothing happens when it already is one.
VersionMarkVersionResultNames the current version: what is saved is committed (when it changed) and gets an annotated tag name with message.
VersionCheckoutSaveResultStarts from a version: what is saved now is committed, then the project's files become those of commit and the document is read again (like ProjectReload). Only while no run is active.
VersionGraphVersionGraph, newest first
